verdict.rationale: Braintrust documents Experiments as the 'immutable, comparable record of your eval runs', tracked over time and wired into CI/CD to catch regressions. Playgrounds also let you run full evaluations and compare results side-by-side across prompts, models, and scorers. Evals can run on every pull request to catch regressions. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of the experiment-to-experiment diff view (per-case score deltas, regression highlighting), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the comparison workflow.
